method: Checked the diff against the actual files rather than reasoning about intent. The change to all three AI sources (embeddings.ts, ingest-extraction.ts, query-planner.ts) is exactly one added import plus one header value each: 'HTTP-Referer' moves from the hardcoded photography.ninochavez.co to SITE_URL. That header is OpenRouter attribution — it identifies the calling app on their dashboard and is never seen by the model. No prompt text, no response schema, no parsing, no model or dimension changed, so generated caption output cannot differ. The caption contract itself (factual retrieval metadata: visible numbers, colors, action, scene; no aesthetic filler, no guessed identity) is unchanged and no caption was regenerated as part of this work.
